title: PAR-07/S8 modeler history-target resolution disposition
mode: Generated fast adapter and result-validator slice
scope: Distinguish a modeler history handle that maps to a captured record from one whose target record was not captured.
Keep handle presence separate from expected object class, reciprocal ownership, history-graph closure, and B-rep semantics.

implementation.classification: historyReference disposition is resolved iff a captured result record has sourceHandle equal to the history target handle; otherwise it is unresolved.
implementation.orderIndependence: Classification is computed at result emission after the full record list has been captured.
implementation.validator: The schema-3 validator recomputes the same classification, binds it to the modeler historyHandle, and rejects stale or misapplied dispositions.
negativeControls: resolved disposition with no captured target record
unresolved disposition with a captured target record
resolved disposition on a non-history edge

limitations: Resolved means only that a record with the same sourceHandle was captured. It does not establish record class, valid ownership direction, transitive graph closure, or valid ACIS geometry. No native consumer or independent kernel ran.
